deepseek_selection.rule: Geomean(code/prose external SSE decode, native fresh ~7K PP), >=5% above default required; 3 excluded warmups +3 timed128-output requests per task. Stateful caches; not a statistically significant or isolated causal comparison. Final 32K reserves differ and are measured separately.

glm_ram_selection.rule: Same32K, native8/8GiB reserves, same diskseed, three shared-method trials. Require functional/retrieval/guards, >=10GiB minimum hostavailable, and >=5% geometricmean(code/prose SSEdecode/nativePP) gain. Stateful caches and only3trials; no statistical significance claim.
